title: MosaicLeaks: Privacy Risks in Querying-in-the-Open for Deep Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.30727v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep research agents increasingly combine private local documents with external tools like web retrieval, creating a privacy risk: an agent's external queries may leak sensitive information from its local context. This risk is amplified by the mosaic effect, where individual queries may appear harmless but become revealing in aggregate. We introduce MosaicLeaks, a benchmark of 1,001 multi-hop deep research tasks that chain private enterprise documents and a public web corpus, forcing agents to make external queries that depend on local information. We evaluate leakage with an adversary LLM that observes only the agent's external queries and attempts to infer private information at three levels: the agent's research intent, answers to specific private questions and verifiable claims about the enterprise documents. translated_title: MosaicLeaks：深度研究智能体开放式查询中的隐私风险
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体日益将私有的本地文档与网页检索等外部工具相结合，这带来了一种隐私风险：智能体发出的外部查询可能会泄露其本地上下文中的敏感信息。这种风险会被“马赛克效应”放大，即单个查询可能看起来无害，但汇总起来却能揭示隐私信息。我们提出了MosaicLeaks，一个包含1,001个多跳深度研究任务的基准，这些任务将私有企业文档与公共网页语料库串联起来，迫使智能体进行依赖于本地信息的外部查询。我们使用一个仅观察智能体外部查询的对抗性大语言模型来评估信息泄露情况，该模型尝试在三个层面推断私有信息：智能体的研究意图、特定私有问题的答案，以及关于企业文档的可验证声明。我们发现，不同家族和不同规模的模型在所有三个层面都频繁发生泄露，而零样本隐私提示（原文摘要至此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出MosaicLeaks基准，首次系统揭示了深度研究智能体在结合私有文档与外部网络查询时，会因“马赛克效应”在多个层面泄露本地敏感信息，且各类模型均存在此问题、现有隐私提示防护效果有限。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MosaicLeaks, a benchmark of 1,001 multi-hop tasks showing that deep research agents' external queries leak private local information at multiple levels due to the mosaic effect, with models across families and sizes frequently leaking despite privacy prompting.
